title: Daily Hype: the widget that hypes you up, a lot
description: A home screen widget with a fresh, over-the-top compliment every 5, 15 or 30 minutes. 281 lines for every mood, streaks and more. Pay once.

hero.headline:
Your biggest fan,

problem.title: Who's the harshest critic you know? Is it you?
problem.text: On the commute, before the interview, on the way home, the voice in your head mostly nags. Daily Hype takes your side from the home screen, several times a day, a little more than seems reasonable. The moment you snort at your phone, some confidence comes back.

features.title: Hype that fits the moment
features.text: Choose from 14 moods and situations like `Morning`, `Commute`, `Rough Day`, `Before an Interview` and `Before a Date`, and a matching line lands on your widget right away. Can't decide? There's `Random` too.

features.title: Keep the ones you love
features.text: Tap the star to save a line to Favorites, and scroll back through past lines in History. Tap `Use This Hype` and it goes straight onto your widget.

features.title: Show up daily and watch it add up
features.text: Every day you check in keeps your streak going. Hit 7, 30 or 100 days in a row, or 50 and 100 days in total, and an achievement unlocks.

items.title: Pick a mood
items.text: Open `Pick a Mood` and tap whatever fits right now.

items.title: Style the widget
items.text: Choose a font, text color, background and refresh interval in Advanced Settings.

items.title: Add it to your home screen
items.text: Touch and hold the home screen, tap +, and find Daily Hype.

reference.title: Make the widget yours
rows: 13 options, including Futura, Georgia and Marker Felt
A two-color gradient, or one of the built-in photos
A new line every 5, 15 or 30 minutes
reference.note: You choose the widget size when you add it to the home screen.

pricing.title: Buy it once and you're done

free.name: The app
items: A home screen widget you can style

pro.name: Support the developer
items: Pick a small, medium or large tip
It doesn't unlock anything. It's simply a way to say thanks
pro.note: Only if and when you feel like it.

pricing.note: No subscription, no extra purchases, no ads.

items.q: How do I add the widget?
items.a: Touch and hold an empty spot on your home screen until the icons jiggle, tap + at the top, search for Daily Hype and pick a size.

items.q: How is the next line chosen?
items.a: When you pick a mood, a line for that mood goes straight onto your widget. After that, the widget shows a random line from all 281 at the refresh interval you chose. You can also tap `Next Hype` in the app to skip ahead.

items.q: Can I change the widget's font or refresh interval?
items.a: Yes. In Advanced Settings you can change the font, text color, background, alignment, line spacing and refresh interval. The interval can be 5, 15 or 30 minutes.

items.q: The widget didn't change right away.
items.a: iOS decides exactly when widgets redraw, so it can run a little behind the interval you picked. Open the app and close it again, and the widget updates.
Each day in a row that you check in adds to your streak. `My Stats` shows your current streak, your best, total days and your achievements.

items.q: My favorites and history are gone.
items.a: Everything is stored only on your device, so it doesn't carry over if you delete the app or switch phones. If you didn't delete the app and it still vanished, please email us.

items.q: Is any of my data sent anywhere?
items.a: No. The app collects no personal data. Your favorites and history stay on your device.

items.q: How do I report a bug or suggest something?
items.a: Right from `Contact the Developer` in the app, or by email or Instagram DM at @lee25_ios. We reply as soon as we've had a look.
